description:
Hold a hire's pay and ask the platform to settle it, when the work was not done or not as agreed.
Use for: work not done, or not as agreed, on a hire whose pay is held. Pay stays held until the platform settles or dismisses the dispute. Use the paying account. Payments in progress can block opening. Listed actions can be refused; hires awaiting worker confirmation may still be disputed. Most accounts get 3 attempts hourly.
Needs: an API key. Hosted sign-in cannot call this yet.
Money: US cents.
Replies omit a field's sole empty value. If null is allowed, only null is omitted; false, [] and a present group stay. A present empty group is {}. Field descriptions explain unavailable values.
Example: open_dispute({"hireId":"a3Fh8kQz1WpL0mNc","category":"not_delivered","description":"The worker confirmed the job and never went to the shops. Nothing was sent by the due time.","urls":["https://storage.example/chat-screenshot.png"]})
Repeat: Once this has worked, a repeat does not do it again while that result still stands: it is refused, or answers with what is already there.
Errors: no_held_pay, not_disputable, paying_account_required, payment_being_reconciled, dispute_opened_reply_failed, dispute_open_outcome_unknown; each error carries `fix`: what to do next.

category.description: The kind of problem. There is no default.

description.description: What went wrong, in your own words: 20 to 2000 characters, not counting spaces at the ends. The platform reads it when it settles the dispute.

hireId.description: The hire id, from list_hires or accept_application.

urls.description: Up to 10 https links to what shows the problem, each up to 2048 characters. Default: no links.

name: open_dispute

actions.description: Tools you may call on this hire now. Each tool still checks.

cost.description: What this hire costs you as its held money stands now: pay plus service fee. Left out when nothing is held: the fee of a pay-later hire is set when you pay.

id.description: The id of the dispute this call opened.

isShownOnHire.description: Whether the hire, read again after the opening, shows this dispute. False: this dispute was dismissed between the opening and the read, or the read cannot show it; `status` and `payStatus` say where the hire stands.

openedAt.description: ISO 8601 time with an offset, for example 2026-11-20T09:00:00-08:00.

outcome.description: How the dispute was settled, as the hire shows it. Left out while it is open, and when isShownOnHire is left out (false).

refundAmount.description: On a split: what was refunded to you. Left out otherwise.

status.description: Where this dispute stands, as the hire shows it. Left out when isShownOnHire is left out (false).

workerAmount.description: On a split: what the worker got. Left out otherwise.

hireId.description: The hire, read again after the dispute was opened: status, payStatus, cost and actions say where it stands. They are returned here also to the owner of a hidden bounty, whom get_hire answers not_found.

status.description: offered: waiting for the worker to confirm. active: working, or fixing a redo. submitted: work waits for your review, or the work is done and its pay waits for you to release or pay it. paid: the pay was released to the worker. disputed: the money is held until the platform settles it. ended: the hire is over without pay, see endedReason.

title: Open a dispute
